metadata.name: Tension Layer Assessment
metadata.description: 4-question diagnostic identifying where in the river the user's flow is stuck

questions.question: When it comes to knowing your direction...

options.label: I have no idea what my thing is
I know my skills but not how they fit together
I have a sense but it's fuzzy
I'm clear on what I do and who I help

questions.question: When you imagine going all-in on your path...

options.label: My body tightens up. I feel anxious or shutdown
I get anxious but can push through sometimes
I notice the fear but it doesn't stop me as much
I feel grounded. I can sit with discomfort

questions.question: When it comes to being seen for your work...

options.label: I hide. Almost nobody knows what I'm working on
I share sometimes but hold back the real stuff
I'm visible online but struggle with deeper exposure
I put myself out there regularly, even when it's scary

questions.question: When it comes to being paid for what you do...

options.label: I can't imagine charging. It feels wrong
I've charged but always feel like I should charge less
I charge but struggle to raise prices or expand
I know my value and price accordingly

discover.name: Discover
discover.description: Where the water first emerges. You can't have a river without finding the source.
discover.when_blocked: You sense there's more inside you, but you can't quite name it yet.
discover.why_first: Without finding the source, there's no river to flow. Visibility, pricing, healing — everything works better once you know your direction.
discover.app_description: Discover your unique skills, the problems you naturally solve, and who you're meant to help.

regulate.name: Regulate
regulate.description: The channel that holds the water. Without it, flow floods, freezes, or dries up.
regulate.when_blocked: You know what to do, but your body keeps pulling the emergency brake.
regulate.why_first: You can't outwork a dysregulated nervous system. Building capacity to hold the pressure comes before pushing for visibility — otherwise you'll burn out or freeze.
regulate.app_description: Build the nervous system capacity to hold your ambition without burning out.

reveal.name: Reveal
reveal.description: Water moving into the open. Visible, felt, carving new paths as it flows.
reveal.when_blocked: You have real gifts, but you're keeping them hidden. The world can't benefit from what it can't see.
reveal.why_first: You have the skills and the capacity — now it's time to let the current run. Graduated courage challenges will expand your comfort zone one step at a time.
reveal.app_description: Show up with courage challenges across 5 visibility layers — from behind a screen to full authority.

value.name: Value
value.description: Where the river meets the world. Vast, deep, receiving and giving back.
value.when_blocked: You're doing the work and people can see it, but you're not owning the price.
value.why_first: This is the final piece. You've found your source, built capacity, and shown up — now it's time to release your value into the world at full price.
value.app_description: Structure your pricing, build your offers, and own what your work is worth.
